prediction_evaluation.conclusion: The revised survival/medical timing still failed to kill the artillery; Steward was the only sustained attacker and was already below M30 V2's 7348.45 output.

failure_chain: Ansel died frame2580; ten later skills/actions failed for absent operators.
Hibiscus died frame3180, Durin frame3330, and Lava frame3780.
First leak armor #21 frame5046; the artillery leaked frame5759 and objective failure began there.
Roadblocks #3/#4/#1/#2 were destroyed at 2025/3168/3234/4965; both protected targets still arrived.

comparison.lesson: Artillery damage and route protection are competing, simultaneous requirements. Neither a marginal survival revision nor V3's high-damage structure alone solved the joint objective.

requirements_for_revision: Change the structural allocation of damage, interception and medicine rather than only renaming roles or shifting enhancement frames.
Explain how enough total artillery damage accumulates before the 5759 leak while all armor/officer lanes remain staffed.
Account for every removal/redeployment gap and who holds each responsibility during it.
If probability is used, provide a verifiable joint lower bound at least 0.0001; otherwise use deterministic mechanics.
